 1    Madam President.  Thank you very much.

 3    resolution -- previously adopted Resolution 433,

 7                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   The 

 8    Secretary will read.

 9                 THE SECRETARY:   Resolution 433, by 

10    Senator Serrano, commemorating the 38th Annual 

11    SOMOS Spring Conference to be held March 7-9, 

12    2025, and paying tribute to its host, SOMOS,  

13    Inc., for its contributions and advocacy on 

14    behalf of the Puerto Rican and Latino communities 

15    in the State of New York.

16                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator 

17    Serrano on the resolution.

18                 SENATOR SERRANO:   Thank you.

19                 I would like to thank the entire 

20    Senate and my colleagues for adopting this 

21    resolution today honoring the 38th anniversary of 

22    the SOMOS Spring Conference happening here in 

23    Albany this weekend.

24                 This conference provides the 

25    opportunity for elected officials, leaders, 


                                                                922

 1    advocates and members of our communities to come 

 2    together under the theme "Justice in Action."

 3                 This year's conference will focus on 

 4    advancing equality, fostering community-driven 

 5    solutions, and empowering the voices of the 

 6    underserved.  Through workshops, panels and 

 7    networking opportunities, participants will 

 8    explore actionable strategies to address pressing 

 9    issues and create meaningful impact.  

10                 The SOMOS Spring Conference serves 

11    as a key gathering to bring people together to 

12    discuss critical issues, and to promote Latino 

13    empowerment.  This conference encourages young 

14    Latinos to get involved and serves as a catalyst 

15    for young leadership.  

16                 I would like to thank 

17    Assemblywoman Karines Reyes, the chair of the 

18    Puerto Rican/Hispanic Task Force, for having me 

19    collaborate with her on this resolution.  I 

20    commend her work and the work of SOMOS, Inc., for 

21    their contributions as hosts of this conference.

22                 Thank you, Madam President, for 

23    allowing me to speak on this resolution, and I 

24    thank my colleagues for supporting it here today.

25                 Thank you.

 1                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Call the

 4                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator 

 5    Fernandez to explain her vote.

 6                 SENATOR FERNANDEZ:   Thank you so 

 7    much, Madam President.  

 8                 This bill is very straightforward 

 9    and very essential because, still, when people 

10    that might have gone through an overdose are 

11    admitted to an emergency room, they're not 

12    directed to the care that could help them get on 

13    their path to recovery.  

14                 So this bill would ensure that any 

15    person that does enter an emergency room on 

16    account of an overdose or anything related is 

17    connected to that care.  

18                 Thank you so much, and I hope 

19    everyone votes aye.

21    Fernandez to be recorded in the affirmative.

25    is passed.
